notes_for_editor: Name and elevation match across tnlandforms (Bulls Gap, 1928') and Forest Lookouts (High Spur, 1,928 ft), so treated as one site. Height 26.5 m is the 1968 planned 87 ft converted, not checked on site. Status standing is from tnlandforms with no date. The nomination's table of towers extant as of March 26, 2014 also lists Bulls Gap in Hawkins County. County: tnlandforms and the state list say Hawkins; Forest Lookouts says Hawkins and Greene. No staffing, access, visit or fire record found. Whether Bulls Gap is one of the compiler's unofficial names is unknown. Agency is from the nomination's title and the 1976 state list numbering.
